# Shifty Habits

> A habit tracker for shift workers. Habits attach to shift types and roster cycles rather than to fixed calendar days, so a rotating roster, a night shift crossing midnight, or a rostered day off does not break tracking the way a conventional habit app does. Android only, free, and all data stays on the device.

Shifty Habits exists because mainstream habit trackers assume a fixed Monday-to-Friday week. Shift workers do not have one. The app replaces the calendar week with the user's actual roster as the unit that habits are scheduled and scored against.

## How it differs from a conventional habit tracker

- **Habits attach to shift types, not weekdays.** A habit assigned to "Night" appears only on night shifts. An optional weekday filter can be applied on top of that.
- **Two roster models.** A repeating cycle (for example 4 days on, 4 nights on, 4 off) or a changing roster typed in month by month. The rest of the app is identical either way.
- **"Today" follows the active shift, not midnight.** A shift starting at 22:00 keeps its habits, reminders and logs on the day the shift started, even after midnight passes. Shifts of up to 72 hours are supported.
- **Streaks skip days a habit does not apply to.** A rostered day off, a non-matching shift type, or a day that has not happened yet is stepped over rather than counted as a miss.
- **Scores can be filtered to one shift type.** A habit's history and score can be narrowed to nights alone or days alone, rather than reporting one blended number.
- **Positive and negative habits both supported**, with a choice of whether a negative habit scores on an inverted scale or the same "higher is better" scale as everything else.

## Privacy and data handling

- No account, no sign-up, no cloud sync, no backend. The app works fully offline.
- All data is stored locally in SQLite on the device.
- The database is excluded from Android cloud backup; device-to-device transfer is allowed.
- Optional anonymous diagnostics (Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics). No habit name, note, time of day, pasted URL or linked package name is ever sent.
- In the UK, the EEA and Switzerland the app asks once on first launch and collects nothing until the user agrees; declining or dismissing leaves it off. Elsewhere diagnostics are on by default and can be turned off at any time in Settings, Privacy. Which applies is decided from the device's own time zone — the app never looks up the user's location.
- Users can export and restore their own data themselves.

## Availability and pricing

- Android, on Google Play, in a growing number of countries with more being added: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.shiftyhabits.app
- No iOS version.
- If it is unavailable in a given country, the developer asks to be emailed at ShiftyHabits@gmail.com with the country, which informs the rollout order.
- The app ships in twelve languages, most of them machine-translated and not yet reviewed by native speakers. Corrections are actively wanted at ShiftyHabits@gmail.com and can be made one phrase at a time.
- Free, with no limit on the number of habits. Backup and restore are free.
- An optional one-off paid upgrade (Pro) adds a longer history window, alternate scoring models, a streak-over-time overlay, more than one active roster cycle, and restoring deleted habits.
- Launch promotion: until 1 January 2027 every Pro feature is free for everyone, and anyone who opens the app before that date keeps Pro permanently, with no purchase.

## Who it is for

Nurses, paramedics, police, firefighters, mining and FIFO workers, factory and plant operators, security staff, hospitality staff, pilots and cabin crew, drivers — anyone on a rotating roster, a 24/7 shift pattern, or night work.

## Guides

Longer-form writing on the site, each answering a question shift workers actually ask:

- **How to build habit consistency when your shifts keep changing** — https://shiftyhabits.com/guides/habit-consistency-with-changing-shifts/
  Anchor habits to shift events (before shift, after shift, first day off) rather than clock times; give each habit a scaled-down version per shift type; measure opportunities taken rather than calendar days.
- **Night shift routines: habits that survive working nights** — https://shiftyhabits.com/guides/night-shift-routine/
  Sleep is the primary habit on nights. Covers protecting the sleep window, bright light early in the shift and darkness on the commute home, stopping caffeine at the shift's halfway point, eating patterns, and the changeover days entering and leaving a night block.
- **Common shift rotation patterns explained** — https://shiftyhabits.com/guides/shift-rotation-patterns/
  4-on-4-off, 2-2-3 (Panama/Pitman), DuPont, Continental (2-2-2-2) and Southern Swing, each drawn day by day with cycle length and shift length. All average 42 hours a week, because 168 hours of weekly cover divided between four crews is 42 hours each.
- **Why your habit streak keeps breaking on days off** — https://shiftyhabits.com/guides/streaks-and-days-off/
  Conventional trackers count calendar days, so a rostered day off is indistinguishable from a skipped day. Streaks should count only applicable days, treat an unlogged day still in progress as pending rather than failed, and keep an overnight shift on the date it started.
